items.desc_now: DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness: delete a session into a recycle bin (15 days by default, adjustable to 7/15/30), restorable or permanently deletable, with bulk delete. DSH 插件：把删掉的会话收进回收站（默认保留 15 天，可改 7/15/30），随时还原或彻底删除，支持批量删除。
items.desc_prev: DSH plugin for DeepSeek Harness: delete a session into a recycle bin (15 days by default, adjustable to 7/15/30), restorable or permanently deletable, with bulk delete and a 10-second undo.

items.desc_now: DeepSeek Harness plugin: on task send, pick the model your subagents run on. Enforced in code on every child DSH starts, workflow agents included: the model, a reasoning-effort ceiling and an output-token cap.
